source.coordinateConversion: Standalone S2V (y,z,x) metres -> browser basis once; native sky_camera offset/scale then skybox_reference rotation/translation. Never recenter, normalize, clip to NAV or scale UV charts again.
source.reference: VRF20.1 WorldLoader.LoadSkybox + EntityTransformHelper; browser shaders, fixed exposure and material adaptation do not establish private Source2 parity.

authoritativePbrPruning.qualification: Only native environment/parallax bundle PBR bindings are removed; original native textures and authored geometry/tints remain. Layered legacy materials keep their base PBR color.

ownReflections.coordinateFrame: Original sky Source positions/volumes/cube orientation/SH. NativeSkyFrame reverses baked main placement for shader positions/normal/view and candidate bounds exactly once.
ownReflections.qualification: Exact original native BC6H faces and authored mips; existing runtime capability fallback remains on devices without BPTC/fragment uniforms/array capacity. No synthetic HDR mip fallback.

shaderCoordinateFrame.position: NativeSkyFrame reconstructs own sky Source coordinates by inverting authored skybox_reference rotation/translation and sky_camera origin/scale once. Geometry stays baked in main-world browser coordinates; raw reflection boxes/cubes/SH stay in own native Source coordinates.
shaderCoordinateFrame.modernEnvironment: Biplanar, wetness and facing fields use own-frame positions/normals; Source-unit bevel displacement uses native sky scale.
shaderCoordinateFrame.atlasCurvature: Source-unit curvature uses0.0254*skyCamera.scale per baked browser metre; main-map default remains1.
shaderCoordinateFrame.clock: Native environment.update is stepped by the same own-sky preparation clock as fog/cloud effects.

toolsMaterials.policy: Native VMAT m_intAttributes contains tools.toolsmaterial; VRF20.1 RenderMaterial.LoadRenderState and Scene.Add exclude exact material batches from normal rendering. No name heuristic.
